predictions.prediction_text: Go long SPX when it’s 2 sigma below the OU-implied mean.
predictions.expected_result: SPX price will rise toward its OU-implied mean before hitting stop-loss levels

predictions.prediction_text: Short SPX when it’s 2 sigma above the OU-implied mean.
predictions.expected_result: SPX price will fall toward its OU-implied mean before hitting stop-loss levels

predictions.prediction_text: Short VIX futures after extreme spikes on the assumption implied volatility will mean-revert down.
predictions.expected_result: Near-term VIX futures prices will decline from spike levels toward typical term-structure-implied levels

predictions.prediction_text: Cover shorts or go long VIX when it’s overly low, betting on a volatility uptick.
predictions.expected_result: VIX futures or implied volatility will increase from low levels

predictions.prediction_text: In a market with low volatility, mean reversion traders can tighten thresholds and increase size because moves are smaller and revert more predictably.
predictions.expected_result: Mean-reversion trades will have higher hit-rate and larger position sizes will realize positive returns due to more predictable reversion

predictions.prediction_text: When short-term implied volatility is far above longer-term implied volatility, near-term implied vol often mean-reverts down, so short near-term SPX options.
predictions.condition: short-term implied vol » long-term implied vol
predictions.expected_result: Short-term implied volatility will decline relative to longer-term implied volatility, producing profits on short near-term SPX options

predictions.prediction_text: Volatility can show aftershocks after spikes, so mean reversion volatility trades should be executed in stages or hedged with spreads to weather multiple surges.
predictions.expected_result: Executing staged entries or hedged spreads will reduce losses from subsequent volatility aftershocks compared with unhedged single-entry short-vol trades

predictions.prediction_text: Microstructure-induced mean reversion occurs at the tick level (e.g., bid-ask bounce), so filter it out when trading true mean reversion.
predictions.expected_result: Filtering microstructure noise will reduce false mean-reversion signals and decrease unprofitable trades

predictions.prediction_text: Pairs trading: when a correlated pair’s price ratio deviates from its mean by a threshold, long the underperformer and short the outperformer expecting the spread to revert.
predictions.condition: pair price ratio deviates beyond threshold
predictions.expected_result: The spread between the two instruments will narrow toward its historical mean, producing profits on the long/short pair trade

predictions.prediction_text: HMMs can identify regime switches, so algorithms should treat inferred trending regimes as likely to continue and mean-reverting regimes as likely to revert.
predictions.expected_result: Assets classified as trending will more likely continue in direction over the near term; assets classified as mean-reverting will more likely reverse toward their mean
